5.3 Indirect identifiers and combination rules
Rule ID
Combination / condition
Action
CPII-101
Username + date of birth
Flag record
CPII-102
Username + email address
Flag record
CPII-103
Date of birth + gender + postcode
Flag record
CPII-104

Flag record
CPII-105
Customer ID + transaction reference details where re-identification is possible

CPII-106
Free-text feedback containing a personal identifier

Flag record
CPII-108

5.4 Processing outcomes
Where a rule explicitly specifies PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK, the stated outcome must be applied. Rules marked as
Block require the affected information to be removed, redacted, or otherwise handled according to the stated policy
requirement.
Note: This is a test policy with intentionally different rule identifiers, terminology, mappings, and logical
combinations.
